spanish: Y décima de flor de harina mezclada en aceite molido cuarto del hin, y libación cuarto del hin vino, al cordero el uno.

findings.issue: כָּתִית is a masculine adjective “beaten/pounded” (modifying the oil); «molido» substitutes grinding/milling.
Masculine עִשָּׂרֹן and masculine passive בָּלוּל are rendered with feminine «décima» and «mezclada»; grammatical smoothing, same participants and passive stem.
findings.spanishSpan: décima de flor de harina mezclada

notes: Other tokens match: two quarters of the hin, libation as wine, and the one lamb, with repetition and cardinal “one” kept.
